gate.title: Personal Vault is a premium feature
gate.description: Keep sensitive information safer in a space protected by a PIN.

transition.title: The Vault is now a premium feature
transition.description: Your Vault already has saved information. To avoid losing access, you can still view your existing data, but adding new entries requires a plan upgrade.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.description: You can still view and recover the data already saved in the Vault. To create new items or edit information, upgrade to a plan that includes the Personal Vault.
readOnly.lockedAction: Available on plans with Personal Vault.
readOnly.createBlocked: Creating new items is only available on plans with Personal Vault.
readOnly.editBlocked: Editing items is only available on plans with Personal Vault.
readOnly.settingsBlocked: Changing sensitive settings is only available on plans with Personal Vault.
